record.paper_title: On the combinatorics of tableaux -- A notebook of open problems
record.original_question: Letρ λ :S n →GL(m,C) be an irreducible representation ofS n with character χλ (som=f λ). Is it possible to count the number ofλ’s for whichρ λ(Sn)⊂SL(m,C)?

evidence.quote: [Stan1999, Ch. 7 Exer. 55(b)] Letρ λ :S n →GL(m,C) be an irreducible representation ofS n with character χλ (som=f λ). Is it possible to count the number ofλ’s for whichρ λ(Sn)⊂SL(m,C)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a positive integer $n$, let $\lambda \vdash n$ denote a partition of $n$, and let $\rho_\lambda : S_n \to \mathrm{GL}(m,\mathbb{C})$ be the irreducible complex representation of the symmetric group $S_n$ associated with $\lambda$, where $m = f^\lambda$ is the dimension of the irreducible representation indexed by $\lambda$ (equivalently, the number of standard Young tableaux of shape $\lambda$). Determine, as a function of $n$, the number
$$ N(n) \;=\; \#\bigl\{ \lambda \vdash n : \rho_\lambda(S_n) \subseteq \mathrm{SL}(m,\mathbb{C}) \bigr\}, $$
i.e., the number of partitions $\lambda$ of $n$ such that $\det \rho_\lambda(\sigma) = 1$ for every $\sigma \in S_n$. Provide a closed-form expression or combinatorial characterization for $N(n)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Ayyer, Prasad, and Spallone (2017, J. Combin. Theory Ser. A; arXiv:1604.08837) give a closed formula for the number of partitions λ of n such that the irreducible representation V_λ of S_n has non-trivial determinant, by analyzing 2-core towers. This directly answers the counting question (the complement gives the count for which ρ_λ(S_n) ⊆ SL(m,C)).

status_evidence.title: Representations of symmetric groups with non-trivial determinant
status_evidence.snippet: Ayyer, Prasad, Spallone give a closed formula for the number of partitions λ of n such that the corresponding irreducible representation V_λ of S_n has non-trivial determinant.
status_evidence.claim: A closed formula counting partitions of n whose irreducible S_n representation has non-trivial determinant has been established, resolving Stanley's exercise.

status_evidence.title: Amritanshu Prasad: Publications
status_evidence.snippet: Work characterizing 2-core towers of partitions giving rise to irreducible representations of S_n with non-trivial determinant.
status_evidence.claim: The determinant question for irreducible S_n representations is answered via 2-core tower characterization.
